prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide quest-journal banner illustration for a whimsical fantasy RPG interface, displayed as a shallow top banner around 120px tall.
Input images: Image 1 is a style and world reference: a richly colored, hand-painted fantasy island map with dense green forest, a distinct mushroom grove, warm red-rock mountains, an old mine, and a glowing stone altar. Image 2 is a character design reference: a friendly brown-haired chibi adventurer with a green outfit and brown leather details. Use these only as visual guidance; create a new original scene.
Scene/backdrop: A warm, hand-drawn fairy-tale RPG landscape on softly textured parchment, with a winding trail passing through a lush forest and oversized mushrooms, then red-rock hills, an ancient mine entrance, and a small stone altar.
Subject: In the left foreground, a brown-haired cloak-wearing swordsman and a kind forest guide pause together to study an unfolded map. The swordsman carries a sheathed sword; the guide has a practical woodland cloak. Their expressions are curious and hopeful. Keep both figures readable at banner scale.
Composition/framing: Extra-wide horizontal panorama, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio (target 1536x512 if supported). Pair of travelers occupies the leftmost quarter; the winding path leads the eye from them across the scene through the landmarks in a clear sequence toward the right. Keep all important elements within the central band; soften/fade the very top and bottom edges into the parchment texture so the artwork crops gracefully as a shallow banner. Complete cohesive scene, not a collage.
Style/medium: Original, warm hand-painted storybook illustration with gentle linework and rounded fantasy-RPG shapes, consistent in palette and mood with the reference island map; not pixel art. Rich but uncluttered, clear silhouettes and readable story at small display size.
Lighting/mood: Soft golden daylight, cozy adventurous mood, subtle atmospheric depth.
Color palette: Pine green, moss green, warm ochre and muted red earth, parchment cream, small accents of sky blue.
Materials/textures: Visible delicate paper grain, painted foliage and rocks, soft watercolor/gouache-like shading.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: The map is a plain map with no writing or symbols that look like letters or numbers. Show exactly two travelers. Keep the whole image fully illustrated, with soft feathered top and bottom edges.
Avoid: Any text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, interface frames, panels, badges, icons, UI-like markers, extra characters, distorted hands, cropping off the travelers, modern objects, hard rectangular edges, or a screenshot of an app. Do not make a full-page UI mockup.
